# Performio

> > AI-powered incentive compensation management (ICM) software specializing in sales commission automation, analytics, and industry-specific solutions for MedTech, financial services, and enterprise sales organizations.

Performio provides enterprise ICM software featuring Analytics Studio for reporting, Plan Builder for compensation design, and integrations with systems like nCino, Jack Henry, Fiserv, and MuleSoft. The platform serves pharmaceutical companies like AstraZeneca and offers pre-configured solutions for regulated industries.

## Key Topics

- Incentive Compensation Management (ICM)
- Analytics Studio
- Plan Builder
- Sales Commission Automation
- Variable Compensation
- Sales Performance Management
- MedTech Solutions
- AI-Powered Compensation
- Commission Reporting
- SPIFs (Sales Performance Incentive Funds)
- Integration Platforms (nCino, Jack Henry, Fiserv, MuleSoft)
- Revenue Generation
- OTE (On-Target Earnings)
- Sales Team Structures
- Commission Plan Design
